[昆政办规〔2023〕2号 enacted pilot arts. 2–9, 22, full-text reproduction](https://zc.51shebao.com/detail/817337), corroborated by the [Kunming fund-centre 2023 launch briefing](https://m.kunming.cn/news/c/2023-11-17/13779800.shtml), broadened voluntary housing-fund participation beyond the older 2020 measure's 12-month pension/hukou test. A qualifying non-full-time, self-employed or new-form worker opens a personal account and agreement, chooses personal deposit timing/amount, pays the entire deposit personally, and can transfer that account on becoming a unit worker. The [2023 centre implementation rules arts. 6–9 and 24, full-text reproduction](https://zc.51shebao.com/detail/818549) add personal-account uniqueness and annual minimum; on conversion to a unit worker, the unit officer may submit identity, account-transfer and labour-relationship evidence, closing the personal account and ending its special subsidy. The personal phase creates no ordinary employer remittance. Art. 22 allows the individual's fund deposit in taxable income only under national tax rules; do not invent an employer wage deduction or tax claim without a valid claimant path. The fund committee [discussed a pilot measure in March 2026](https://www.sohu.com/a/1003193952_121106902); no promulgated successor was found in this pass, so exact 2026 amendment status remains open.
